Spacious, beautiful, fresh food, delicious!
Apr 2026 • Friends
The bar space is pretty, bright and modern, suitable for eating with friends or lightly dating. The yellow light creates a cosy feeling, the chair table is neat and clean.

I called the Thai seafood pad, the food came up pretty fast. Soft fibers, not glued, sour – sweet – salty taste is pretty good. Fresh shrimp and ink, food does not melt. Included in price, lemon and peanuts should be easy to adjust for taste.

In addition, there is a Thai-style seafood garlic, a light spicy taste, which is quite delicious and suitable for taste.
